# customer-journey-dns-security-mockup.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup, screen 11 of the customer journey flow.
**Source context:** `## Customer Journey screen flow`, step 11, the
mandatory, pre-selected DNS Security add-on priced by the Gold plan the
user selected earlier.

Left nav tree shows `DNS Security` selected under `Add-ons
Subscription`, with `Firewall as a Service` still greyed/not yet
reached. Right panel "DNS Security" ("Includes DNS Protocol Filtering,
DNS Name Filtering and Protective DNS for all actors") with a single
pre-checked, non-editable option `Gold DNS Security` (€1,5 per actor a
month) totalling `52,5` in the Monthly Recurrent Charge € column. `OK`
(highlighted/clicked) and `Cancel` buttons.
